newsitem.title: EGYPT: Suspected militants kill 5, wound 8 in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Suspected militants kill 5, wound 8 in Egypt.

text.p: Suspected Moslem militants shot dead five people, including four policemen, and wounded eight in southern Egypt on Tuesday night, the interior ministry and security sources said.
Four unidentified men with machineguns attacked two police vehicles in a crowded area in the town of Manfalut, 300 km (190 miles) south of Cairo, the sources said on Wednesday morning.
Four policemen as well as a civilian caught in the line of fire were killed, security sources said.
Six policemen, including a captain, and two civilians were wounded in the ambush, the interior ministry said in a statement. Their condition was not yet known.
The attackers fled in a stolen car, the ministry said.
It was the most serious attack since six imprisoned militant leaders announced a truce call in July.
The appeal, however, was rejected by exiled leaders of the Gama'a al-Islamiya, the main militant Islamic organisation fighting the government.
More than 1,000 people have been killed since the Gama'a took up arms in 1992 to overthrow the government and set up a strict Islamic state.
